description: Calculate fair tip distribution for restaurant staff using tip pooling policy. Apply 20/80 split between support and service staff, calculate proportional distributions based on hours worked, and handle multi-role staff. Total tips: $2,850.

natural_language.prompt: Complete the tip pooling spreadsheet for restaurant staff. The total tips are $2,850. Support staff get 20%, service staff get 80%. Distribute proportionally based on hours worked. One staff member worked both roles.
